headline: eMudhra Shares Fall 20% Following Cryptographic Flaw Disclosure
summary: Digital trust and cybersecurity firm eMudhra saw its shares drop 20% after acknowledging a cryptographic flaw that generated weak private keys.
why: eMudhra provides digital signature and cybersecurity solutions where cryptographic integrity is paramount for customer trust and regulatory compliance.

impacts.name: eMudhra
impacts.why: Disclosure of a critical security vulnerability eroded client trust and triggered a sharp sell-off in the company's stock.

why_moved: Discovery of a severe cryptographic weakness in its security products led to an immediate 20% plunge in share value.
